description: Defines the MappingContext interface for configuring message mappers, including engine type, options, and conditions, with associated JSON field definitions.

classes.name: MappingContext
classes.description: Interface for mapping configuration, including methods to retrieve engine, options, conditions, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MappingContext.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for MappingContext properties.

methods.name: getMappingEngine
methods.description: Returns the name of the mapping engine used for message mapping.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Deprecated method returning options as string key-value pairs, converting from JSON options.

methods.name: getOptionsAsJson
methods.description: Returns all configuration options as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to validate before mapping incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to validate before mapping outgoing messages.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to JSON including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
